name: HospitalRun
notes: Volunteer burnout; v2 React rewrite was never completed despite 6.9k stars. Formal closure announced Oct 2025.

name: OpenClinica Community Edition
notes: Community Edition v3.x receives only maintenance updates; all active development moved to commercial OpenClinica Enterprise. No formal archive.

name: OpenEDC (legacy prototype)
notes: Explicitly labelled as legacy prototype; current OpenEDC product is proprietary SaaS at openedc.health.

name: Ginkgo CADx
notes: Continuation fork of MetaEmotion original (also abandoned). Archived Nov 2021; VTK/wxWidgets porting complexity cited and diminished maintainer interest.

name: FreeMedForms
notes: Configurable open-source medical suite. SourceForge release 2019; freemedforms.com website also inactive.

name: medintux
notes: French medical cabinet management software integrating Sesam Vitale and CIM10. No updates since 2015.

name: Open DICOM Viewer
notes: Java-based DICOM viewer for web and patient CDs. No updates since 2013; Alpha status at abandonment.

name: Epi Info
notes: CDC-created outbreak investigation and survey tool used worldwide. CDC officially ended support September 30 2025. Community Edition (C#) exists with 24 stars; Python package updated July 2025 but no evidence of meaningful community continuation.
